questions.title: Top N Most Frequent Words
questions.description:
Given a line of text, find the `n` most frequently occurring words.

### Input

Two lines:

1. An integer `n`.
2. A single line of space-separated lowercase words.

### Output

Print the `n` most frequent words, **one per line**, in the format:

```
word count
```

**Ordering rule:** sort by count **descending**. If two or more words have the same count, break the tie **alphabetically ascending** (`a` before `b`).

**Fewer-than-`n` case:** if the text contains fewer than `n` *distinct* words, print all of the distinct words (following the same ordering rule) instead of padding the output.

### Example

Input:
```
3
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the fox
```

Output:
```
the 3
fox 2
brown 1
```

`the` appears 3 times and `fox` appears 2 times, so they take the top two spots. Six words are tied with a count of 1 (`quick`, `brown`, `jumps`, `over`, `lazy`, `dog`); the tie is broken alphabetically, so `brown` — the alphabetically-first of the six — fills the third spot.

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    n = int(data[0].strip())

main()

all words distinct: every word ties at count 1, so output is purely alphabetical
longer input with mixed counts and a tie among the top results
